concepts.gloss_en: the insights/understandings of the Torah; longer variant adds 'to its depth' (לעמקה) as an adverbial qualifier, same construct head תבונות התורה

members.note: representative; base construct 'insights of the Torah'

same construct head תבונות התורה, same Torah (lm1:11); לעמקה = 'to its depth' is an adverbial qualifier not a distinct construct head. Plausibly the same concept, but the depth-qualifier may mark a distinct 'reaching the insights deeply' notion — leave for human

notes: Both forms occur only in lm1:11 and share the head תבונות התורה. The only difference is the adverbial לעמקה ('to its depth'), not a different possessed/construct head, so this is not a rule-4 head mismatch. Kept together but tiered 'question' since it is genuinely uncertain whether 'insights of Torah in their depth' is a distinct concept from the bare 'insights of Torah.'
